compounds.name: Magnoflorine
compounds.bridge_relevance: Downstream of neuroinflammatory cascades driven by DDR-gene defects (e.g. TREX1, SAMHD1). The triangle query: given a synthetic lethal pair where one gene drives neuroinflammation, does Caspase-3 inhibition selectively rescue?
compounds.ddr_relevance: indirect - Caspase-3 is the executioner, not the DDR gene; but DDR defects that drive neuroinflammation converge on Caspase-3.

molecule.source: Plant natural product (Magnolia, Coptis, Tinospora, Aristolochia species)
molecule.notable: Quaternary ammonium cation — affects BBB permeability. BBB predictor should flag this.

compounds.name: PARP inhibitors (olaparib, niraparib, rucaparib)
compounds.pathway_modulated: PARP1/2 single-strand break repair inhibition -> synthetic lethal in HR-deficient backgrounds
compounds.bridge_relevance: PARP inhibitors are the clinical proof-of-concept for synthetic lethality. The DDR-Neuro bridge reframes them: which neurological contexts (BRCA2 carriers with cognitive decline, ATM heterozygotes) might benefit or be harmed?
compounds.ddr_relevance: direct - PARP1 is in the 233-gene CicciaLab screen; PARP inhibition is the canonical DDR-targeting therapeutic.

compounds.name: Hesperetin
compounds.bridge_relevance: Oxidative stress is the dominant neurotoxic mechanism in NER-deficient neurons (Cockayne, XP). Hesperetin as an antioxidant is a candidate for ERCC6/ERCC8-deficient contexts.
compounds.ddr_relevance: indirect - targets the ROS elevation caused by NER failure.

molecule.source: Citrus fruits (oranges, lemons, grapefruit); aglycone of hesperidin.
molecule.notable: Planar flavonoid scaffold — better BBB permeability than the aporphine alkaloid Magnoflorine. BBB predictor should score this higher.

compounds.name: Pimecrolimus
compounds.bridge_relevance: Discovered from the pimecrolimus SH-SY5Y extraction (molecule_metadata present). A macrolactam calcineurin inhibitor; docks into apoptotic-pathway protein active sites. Candidate for neuroinflammatory contexts downstream of DDR defects.
compounds.ddr_relevance: indirect - calcineurin / apoptosis modulation, not a direct DDR target. Large MW (810 Da) flagged as BBB-impermeable by rule-based prediction.

molecule.notable: Large macrolactam (MW 810) — will be flagged as BBB-impermeable by rule-based predictors. Formulation (e.g., nanoparticle, intranasal) required for CNS use.

compounds.name: Flavonoid library (polyphenolic natural products)
compounds.bridge_relevance: Discovered from the flavonoids mitochondrial-cascade extraction. Library-scale in-silico screen of flavones/flavanones/flavonols/isoflavones targeting the mitochondrial cascade - a distinct upstream intervention point from direct Caspase-3 inhibition.
compounds.ddr_relevance: indirect - mitochondrial cascade is downstream of DDR-driven neurodegeneration (POLG/POLG2 mitochondrial DNA repair defects).

molecule.class: Polyphenolic natural products (flavones, flavanones, flavonols, isoflavones)
molecule.source: Plant secondary metabolites across fruits, vegetables, tea, medicinal herbs.
molecule.notable: Library-scale: average MW ~270 Da (planar scaffold) — generally favorable BBB permeability. The BBB predictor should score this family as BBB-penetrant on average, with subclass-specific variation.
